summary.tldr: Raises the federal tax credits for volunteer firefighters and search and rescue volunteers from $6,000 to $10,000, and updates the firefighter service definition.
what_it_does: Raises the amount used to calculate the volunteer firefighter tax credit from $6,000 to $10,000.
Raises the amount used to calculate the search and rescue volunteer tax credit from $6,000 to $10,000.
Expands the definition of eligible volunteer firefighting services to include being available or on call for firefighting, emergency services, and non-emergency duties.
Allows volunteer firefighters to receive nominal pay, as long as it is not a liveable wage.
Applies these changes to the 2026 tax year and later.
summary.background: The bill amends sections 118.06 and 118.07 of the Income Tax Act.
